title: Scripture and Worship
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Scripture and worship teaches that God’s Word reveals who God is and teaches His people how to respond to Him with reverence, praise, prayer, obedience, and holy devotion. Worship must be shaped by God’s truth, not human invention.
summary: Scripture and worship teaches that God’s Word reveals who God is and teaches His people how to respond to Him with reverence, praise, prayer, obedience, and holy devotion. Worship must be shaped by God’s truth, not human invention.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the center of true worship. Through Him, believers come to the Father, worship in Spirit and truth, and join the redeemed in praising the Lamb who was slain and is worthy forever.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Worship begins with God’s revelation of Himself. People do not have the right to invent God according to preference or approach Him on their own terms. Scripture reveals His holiness, glory, mercy, greatness, works, commands, and saving grace.

God’s Word teaches His people to worship with reverence and joy. Worship includes praise, thanksgiving, prayer, confession, singing, hearing the Word, obedience, and offering the whole life to God. True worship is not limited to emotion, music, style, or location.

Scripture also corrects false worship. God is not honored by worship that ignores His truth, centers human pride, excuses sin, entertains without reverence, or uses religious activity while the heart remains far from Him.

In Christ, worship is restored. The redeemed worship God because the Lamb was slain and has purchased people for God. Christian worship is therefore Gospel-shaped, Christ-centered, Spirit-enabled, Scripture-filled, and directed to the glory of God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Without Scripture, worship can become self-focused, shallow, manipulative, emotionalism, performance, or tradition without truth. People may chase an experience while missing God Himself. Others may think worship is only what happens in a church service, rather than a whole life offered to the Lord.

This doctrine reminds believers that worship is not about pleasing the crowd, displaying talent, or manufacturing a feeling. Worship is the right response of redeemed people to the living God who has revealed Himself and saved them through Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture shape your worship. Sing truth, pray truth, hear truth, obey truth, and offer your life to God with reverence and gratitude. Do not measure worship only by emotion or outward form. Ask whether Christ is honored, God’s Word is central, the Spirit is at work, and your heart is being led toward faith, repentance, obedience, and praise.
